traits.name: Irritating Dander
traits.text: A creature that hits the goblin dog with an unarmed attack, tries to Grapple it, or otherwise touches it is exposed to goblin pox.

traits.name: Juke
traits.text: ⬲ Requirements A creature must be mounted on the goblin dog. Trigger The rider issues a command to the goblin dog. Effect The goblin dog Steps before following the command.

traits.name: Goblin Pox
traits.text: (disease); Saving Throw DC 17 Fortitude. Stage 1 sickened 1 (1 round) Stage 2 sickened 1 and slowed 1 (1 round) Stage 3 sickened 2 and can't reduce its sickened value below 1. (1 day)

traits.name: Scratch
traits.text: ⬺ (manipulate); The goblin dog vigorously scratches itself, exposing all adjacent creatures to goblin pox.

actions.name: Melee
actions.text: ⬻ jaws +9 Damage 1d6+3 (1d6+3) piercing plus goblin pox
